name: base
title: Hairline base
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: Hairline design tokens, the Tailwind theme and the type utilities. Use when installing any Hairline component — everything depends on it.
docs: Import the Hairline theme once at the top of your global stylesheet: `@import "@hairline/tokens/theme.css";` — or copy the tokens in directly. Hairline sets font-variant-numeric on every figure; do not override it, and never set a figure in the sans inside a table.
